mines.mine_notes: Open pit gold-silver mine, central BC; first gold pour Jan 2025; declared commercial production May 1, 2025. FY2025: 3,940,316 t milled @ 1.51 g/t Au (Q4: 1.66 g/t, 88.1% recovery); gold produced 192,808 oz (164,289 oz post-commercial); gold sold 164,827 oz (post-commercial). Post-commercial cash cost US$717/oz and AISC US$869/oz (Q4: US$779 cash cost, US$925 AISC). Net income C$349.2M; operating cash flow C$560.7M. Reserves per Dec 15, 2025 news release (unchanged from 2024 Expansion Study; 2025 AIF PDF not publicly accessible); 2025 AIF confirmed reserves figures not independently available.
mines.processing: Crushing, SAG/ball grinding, gravity and CIL leach with carbon regeneration
